name: Naruse Akari
source:
A girl who is one of Sayaka's students and serves as the class representative in the class where Sayaka is the assistant homeroom teacher.

She is serious and quiet, and is generally perceived as the kind of girl who always sits alone reading a book in the classroom.

She enjoys watching movies and is also a member of the drama club.

Within the drama club, however, she doesn't perform as an actress. Instead, she handles tasks such as writing scripts.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11291]the official site[/url]]
